project.name: Motor Starter Reference System
project.description: 480 VAC motor starter with 24 VDC PLC control and field limit switch

deviceTypes.description: 3-pole contactor, 24 VDC coil, 1 NO auxiliary contact
Two-wire mechanical limit switch with one normally open dry contact
Three-phase induction motor load with protective earth
Three-pole overload relay with one NC auxiliary contact
Compact 24 VDC PLC with two digital inputs and two digital outputs
AC-input power supply with a regulated 24 VDC output
Normally closed momentary pushbutton for a stop circuit
480 VAC three-phase source with protective earth
Eight-position terminal block with isolated terminal points

construction.shield_construction: overall foil shield with drain wire

devices.description: 480 VAC line-to-line to 24 VDC control power supply
Normally open field limit switch permissive

jumpers.description: Distributes +24 VDC from TB1.1 to the LS1 cable feed at TB1.2

cables.description: LS1 field cable; conductor 2- is a terminated spare

relations.description: PLC1 output controls the K1 coil through the stop and overload chain
CB1 provides branch protection for M1
